extracted.intended_audience: authors (self-published and traditionally published), publishers, and Kirkus subscribers / prospective customers
extracted.subtask_description: Frequently asked questions and procedural rules about using Kirkus services — how to get a book reviewed (traditional vs self-published), subscription/payment/cancellation policies, account management, and copyright/licensing rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copyright and reproduction
rubrics_metrics.description: All material on this site is copyrighted by Kirkus Media LLC. Further reproduction without written permission from the publisher is strictly prohibited.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You may license the Kirkus’ database of book reviews for use in your products; contact Kirkus for licensing details (link provided).

rubrics_metrics.name: How to get your book reviewed
rubrics_metrics.description: If you are a publisher or an author published by a traditional publishing company (i.e., you did not finance the publication of your book), please see the publisher submission guidelines. If you are a self-publisher, please read about Kirkus Indie, our review service for independent authors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the separate submission path appropriate to your publishing model: publisher submission guidelines for traditionally published books; Kirkus Indie for self-published books (links provided).

rubrics_metrics.name: Subscription information and pricing
rubrics_metrics.description: For subscription information, please click the subscription information link.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific prices and subscription options (print/online, annual/monthly) are provided on the subscription information page linked from the FAQ.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment security
rubrics_metrics.description: All payments are processed on our secure website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This means your order cannot be read as it travels over the Internet, so your name, address and credit card information are secure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Paying by check or money order (conditions)
rubrics_metrics.description: You can purchase a 12-month print/online combo subscription with a check or money order in U.S. currency drawn on a U.S. bank. We are unable to accept check or money order payments for monthly subscriptions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mail payment to Kirkus Media, LLC (address provided). Include first name, last name, company, job/title, address, phone number, email address and a username and password you would like to use (between 4 and 15 characters). Also include a hint question with answer to help retrieve your password. Activation occurs when payment is received.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cancellation policy & problem resolution
rubrics_metrics.description: If you have a problem with Kirkus' service, please let us know by sending an email to customercare@kirkus.com and we will do our best to resolve the problem for you.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You may also call 1-800-316-9361 from 9:00 am to 5:00 pm CST Monday through Friday. To help improve the service, Kirkus asks subscribers to let them know why they want to cancel.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ordering a gift subscription
rubrics_metrics.description: You can order an annual print/online gift subscription to Kirkus Reviews by contacting Kirkus for instructions at customercare@kirkus.com.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact customer care for the process and any required information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account sharing prohibited
rubrics_metrics.description: If I sign up for a subscription to Kirkus Reviews, may I share my username and password with my friends and colleagues? No.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sharing would violate the terms of service and be grounds for termination of your account. Someone who signs on as you could change your username and password and access your credit card information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Group subscription program
rubrics_metrics.description: If you have a large group of people for whom to purchase this service, Kirkus offers a program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Email customercare@kirkus.com to receive information about the group program.

rubrics_metrics.name: Membership activation timing
rubrics_metrics.description: How long does it take for my membership to be activated from the time payment is made?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: As soon as your payment is authorized and you choose a username and password, you have immediate access to the Kirkus.com book review database.

rubrics_metrics.name: Billing schedule for annual subscribers
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Annual subscribers are billed the day they sign up.

rubrics_metrics.name: Forgotten or lost password procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: I've forgotten or lost my password. What do I do?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: On the 'Log In' page, click 'retrieve it' to get your username or 'reset it' to reset your password. If you still encounter problems, email customercare@kirkus.com and customer service will assist you.

rubrics_metrics.name: Updating account information
rubrics_metrics.description: How do I update my account information (email, name/address, credit card information)?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To change your email, name or address, log in with your user ID and password and click on 'Manage Account.' To change your credit card information, call customer service at 1-800-316-9361.

rubrics_metrics.name: Customer contact information
rubrics_metrics.description: Need Help? Contact Kirkus customer care for assistance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact options provided: phone 1-800-316-9361 or email customercare@kirkus.com (hours 9:00 am to 5:00 pm CST Monday–Friday).
